create_convert_to_unicode: create a function that converts text to Unicode assuming UTF-8 input
run_strip_accents: run a function that strips accents from a piece of text using Unicode NFD normalization
test_convert_to_unicode: test the convert_to_unicode function with binary and text inputs
test_run_strip_accents: test the run_strip_accents function with accented characters like café and naïve
summarize_lower_pipeline: summarize the stdin pipeline that lowercases, converts to unicode, and strips accents from each line
